Your 18 items, each one tested in the practice planner

I clicked through every one of these in real Safari on the practice copy before writing a word about it. Nothing has been built and nothing has touched your planner — this is the review you asked for.

Reproduced — I made them happen and measured them: 3 (habits will not open), 4 (Location reverts), 5 (vague Undo wording), 7 (TODAY/TOMORROW dead), 8 (routines in Completed), 11 (focus alarm silent), 12 (future branch invisible), 13 (space deleted), 14 (cannot pick a branch), 16 (conflict on the wrong day).

Confirmed missing — the feature is simply not there: 1 (resize a picture), 10 (repeat until acknowledged), 15 (rainbow colour picker), and half of 9 (the calendar button; the hide box already shipped).

I could NOT reproduce, and I say so rather than guessing: 2 (the flickering demo branch) and 6 (a new habit missing from the calendar). Both cards ask you one question so I can chase the right thing.

Needs more proof before I would call it fixed: 17 and 18 — I can see the cause in the stored data but have not watched it across several weeks.

three of these share ONE root cause

Cards 16, 17 and 18 are the same bug wearing three faces. A focus session stores a weekday, never a date:

{id:"A", from:"09:00", to:"10:00", days:[1], timer:25}

So every Monday is the same Monday: the conflict check cannot tell them apart (16), the pop-up works its day out from the weekday rather than the occurrence you clicked (17), and there is nowhere to record "just this once" (18). I would fix them as one change, not three patches.

the standout, because it is a one-word bug

Card 11: when the focus timer reaches zero it calls playAlarmSound. That function is mentioned 3 times and defined 0 times. It does not exist. The timer runs down, calls nothing, and you hear nothing.

Worth adding a check that fails the build when a function is called but never defined — that would have caught this before it ever reached you.

what I need from you

Approve the ones you want, card by card. Five cards ask you a question (1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 15) — each answer changes what I build, so I would rather ask now than show you the wrong thing later.

Your planner stays on build 2026-09-23 12:41 until you say otherwise.

The focus session alarm never fires

NOT LIVE

⚠  NOT LIVE — waiting on your word

Where: the focus session timer.

"The focus sesion alarm is not working, it doesn't notificy me that its over."

the cause, measured, and how I fix it

Found the cause with certainty, and it is a one-word bug.

When the timer reaches zero it calls a function named playAlarmSound.

playAlarmSound — mentioned 3 times, defined 0 times

The function does not exist. The timer runs down, calls nothing, and you hear nothing — exactly what you reported. Nothing plays and no notification is raised anywhere in that code path.

How I would fix it: define it — a short chime, plus a notification if you have allowed them, plus the pop-up saying the session is over. And a check that fails the build if a function is ever called without being defined, so this class of bug cannot ship again.

Typing a space in a branch name deletes it

NOT LIVE

⚠  NOT LIVE — waiting on your word

Where: the priority tree → renaming a branch.

"in willingboro a branch, it has a glitch that when I press space and it deltes the space i put in."

the cause, measured, and how I fix it

Reproduced with real keystrokes in Safari. I put the cursor at the end of "Willingboro", pressed space then X, and the title stayed "Willingboro" — both characters were thrown away.

Likely cause: the name is an editable text span, and something redraws the row while you are typing, replacing what you typed with the stored name. The space is just where it shows first, because a space is what triggers the redraw.

How I would fix it: nothing redraws a row while you are typing in it. The row refreshes when you finish, not mid-word — the same rule that fixed notes losing text on 2026-09-22.

16

The conflict warning fires against the wrong day

NOT LIVE

⚠  NOT LIVE — waiting on your word

Where: moving a future-dated focus session.

"I am moving a future dated focus session a couple of hours ahead but i am getting this message that it conflicts with another session, but its conflickting with previus days session not on that specific date session."

the cause, measured, and how I fix it

Found the cause in the data. A focus session is stored like this:

{id:"A", name:"Monday block", from:"09:00", to:"10:00", days:[1], timer:25}

It carries a WEEKDAY, not a date. So every Monday is the same Monday as far as the conflict check is concerned — it cannot tell this Monday from last Monday, and warns you about a session on a different date entirely.

How I would fix it: the conflict check compares the actual DATE you are moving to, not the weekday, so only a session genuinely on that day can clash.

The picture shows: measured from the stored data: days:[1] with no date anywhere in the record

Changing a duration "every week" does not change later weeks

NOT LIVE

⚠  NOT LIVE — waiting on your word

Where: the focus session → change the duration → choose Every week.

"when I change the duration, and the pop up comes for change for everyweek. it doesn't change the following weeks. that nees to be fixed"

the cause, measured, and how I fix it

Same root cause as cards 16 and 17, and I want to be straight that I have not yet proven this one end to end — it needs a session watched across several weeks.

What I can say from the data: a session has ONE from and ONE to for every occurrence. So "just this date" has nowhere to store an exception, and "every week" has nothing to spread. That fits what you are seeing.

How I would fix it: give a session a list of exceptions by date. "Just this date" writes one exception; "every week" changes the session itself and clears exceptions after that date.
